summary: Matador Resources, through wholly owned MRC Ranger, LLC, closed its purchase of all membership interests in Paloma Permian, LLC from Paloma Permian Holdings and Intermediate on October 1, 2026, per a July 22, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement. Stated consideration was $1.275 billion cash, subject to customary working-capital, title and environmental adjustments; the as-adjusted closing price paid was approximately $1.255 billion. Target assets are proved undeveloped acreage and producing properties in Eddy and Lea Counties, New Mexico. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch post-closing adjustments and integration/permian overlap implications.
